subject.title: Agent loop allows simulated tool calls instead of enforcing real tool invocation

question: What should OpenClaw do when an ordinary agent turn ends with assistant text that looks like a tool call or tool result but no structured tool call was emitted?
rationale: The source gap is concrete, but the default behavior is a product/security boundary because fail-closed enforcement, warning-only compatibility, bounded repair, and forced-tool retries have different local-model and upgrade tradeoffs.

options.title: Fail or suppress by default
options.body: Treat unstructured fake tool-call/tool-result final text as unsafe output, block normal delivery, and require a structured tool call or clear error path.

options.title: Keep warning-only compatibility
options.body: Preserve current behavior, document provider-template fixes, and accept that fake tool-looking text can still reach users as text.

options.title: Add opt-in strict mode first
options.body: Keep current defaults while adding a documented strict enforcement mode with tests for JSON, XML, ReAct, and false-positive cases.

recommendation.title: Fail or suppress by default
recommendation.body: Treat unstructured fake tool-call/tool-result final text as unsafe output, block normal delivery, and require a structured tool call or clear error path.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice is a core security/product boundary and the current related implementation history points to this owner most directly.
